756a50de9c58b198.description: Department: B2C Credit, Product Location: KSA Description Tabby creates financial freedom in the way people shop, earn and save by reshaping their relationship with money. Over 25 million users choose Tabby to stay in control of their spending and make the most out of their money. The company’s flagship offering allows shoppers to split their payments online and in-store with no interest or fees. Over 70,000 global brands and small businesses, including Amazon, Noon, IKEA, and SHEIN use Tabby to accelerate growth and gain loyal customers by offering easy and flexible payments online and in stores. Tabby generates over $18 billion in annual transaction volume for its partner brands and is the highest-rated, most-reviewed, largest, and fastest-growing FinTech in the GCC region. Tabby launched in 2019 and has since raised +$1 billion in equity and debt funding from global and regional investors, and is now valued at $6,5 billion. About the role Tabby is known for BNPL, but credit is our fastest-growing business. Saudi Arabia is our biggest market, and we want to build a full consumer lending line there. We are looking for a Senior Product Manager based in Saudi Arabia to build that business from the ground up and own its P&L. This is not a feature role. You will define what the product is, how it is priced, who qualifies, how it stays compliant. What you will be doing The product construct. Define the lending products we launch in KSA and across Tabby's other markets, including eligibility, tenors, limits, repayment structure, and what happens at every edge of the flow. The P&L. Revenue and cost are yours: profit rates and pricing etc. You build the business case, commit to the numbers, and explain every month why they moved. Work with legal, compliance and external partners, and so the customer experience does not suffer for it. Billing and servicing logic. Billing logic, repayment options, early settlement, late fees, collections hand-offs. This is detailed work: you will sit with engineering and specify, case by case, what lands where and why. Strategy. Where this business should be in 12 and 24 months, which segments we serve, what we build next, and what we deliberately do not build. What you will need Saudi Arabia residency, familiarity with the market and an understanding of local culture 3+ years of experience as a Product Manager. Experience with credit or lending products matters most, but strong experience in fin-tech or tech products also works A proven track record of managing complex product lifecycles and delivering successful products Attention to detail, our products work with people's money, so precision matters at every step Comfort working with risk, compliance and legal to get a product approved, not just designed Resilience and the ability to adapt in a rapidly changing environment Fluency in English and Arabic Benefits What you can expect Ownership & Impact: A working environment that gives you autonomy and responsibility from day one. Culture: Collaborative, inclusive, and driven environment where your voice matters. Flexibility: Enjoy flexible working hours designed to optimize productivity and balance. Growth: Participate in the company’s employee stock options program and shape your career trajectory. Support: Comprehensive health insurance, generous PTO and a Flexible Benefits budget to meet your personal needs. We are passionate about creating an inclusive, high-performing workplace that gives people from all backgrounds the support they need to thrive, grow, and meet their goals (whatever they may be). If this sounds exciting to you, we’d love to hear from you!

759f099817b06e7e.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة تقنيات التبريد الذكي عن مهندس ميكانيكي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتطلب هذا الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الهندسة الميكانيكية، وهو متاح بدوام كامل. سيقوم المهندس بإعداد التصاميم والمخططات للمشاريع الميكانيكية، بالإضافة إلى تطوير برامج التشغيل والصيانة للمعدات الصناعية. نظرة عامة على المسؤوليات يتولى المهندس الميكانيكي مسؤولية شاملة في دورة حياة المشاريع الهندسية، بدءاً من التصميم وحتى التشغيل والصيانة. يشمل ذلك إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة لضمان سير العمل بكفاءة ووفقاً للمعايير المعتمدة. المهام الرئيسية إعداد التصاميم والمخططات لمشاريع الهندسة الميكانيكية، بما في ذلك المولدات، التوربينات، وحدات التكييف، المراجل، وشبكات التوزيع لأنظمة التدفئة والتكييف والتبريد. تطوير خطط وبرامج تجميع وتركيب التجهيزات الميكانيكية للمشاريع الصناعية، وتحديد أنظمة الضبط والتحكم اللازمة. إعداد برامج تشغيل المعدات وبرامج الصيانة الوقائية بناءً على تعليمات الشركات المصنعة، ومتابعة تنفيذ هذه الإجراءات. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة أحدث التطورات التقنية في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالأعمال والمشاريع الهندسية، وتوضيح نسب تقدمها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الهندسة الميكانيكية. القدرة على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الهندسية بدقة. معرفة ببرامج تشغيل المعدات الصناعية وأنظمة الصيانة الوقائية. القدرة على إعداد التقارير الفنية والوثائق المتخصصة. بيئة العمل يتمركز هذا الدور في مدينة الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية، وهو وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق شركة تقنيات التبريد الذكي. الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريقنا، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم عبر القنوات المتاحة.

75363b04615d657f.description: About MARAFID MARAFID operates as the execution arm of Riyadh Holding Company, focusing on the development and activation of economic infrastructure. The company specializes in three core sectors: Logistics & Mobility, Industrial Clusters, and Circular Economy. MARAFID integrates development, asset management, leasing, and strategic partnerships to deliver projects and services that support business activities and cater to the needs of operators, tenants, and investors. Its portfolio includes logistics parks, truck stations, parking facilities, specialized industrial hubs, and infrastructure for material aggregation, reuse, and recycling. Digital solutions and shared services are utilized to manage these assets and their connections with served businesses. Through collaborations with public and private sector partners, MARAFID aims to connect land, infrastructure, and operational expertise to support Riyadh’s economic growth. The Role of Circular Economy Director MARAFID is seeking a Circular Economy Director to manage and coordinate the company’s circular economy ecosystem operations. This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and involves overseeing sector assets, services, and ecosystem participants to facilitate efficient resource recovery, strengthen circular value chains, and support sustainable sector growth. The role requires 5-10 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Oversee circular economy ecosystem operations, coordinating activities across MARAFID’s recovery, recycling, reuse, and circular economy assets, services, and initiatives. Manage the operational performance of circular economy assets and services, monitoring utilization, material volumes, service levels, revenues, costs, and other key operational indicators. Coordinate with recyclers, waste generators, collectors, service providers, and other ecosystem participants to facilitate efficient movement and recovery of materials across the circular value chain. Manage and enhance circular economy services and platforms, supporting material exchange, resource recovery, traceability, and connectivity between supply and demand. Identify and implement operational improvement opportunities to increase recovery rates, asset utilization, service quality, operational efficiency, and value generated from recovered materials. Support the launch and operationalization of new circular economy offerings. Monitor sector demand, material flows, and operational trends to identify opportunities to enhance existing services and support future ecosystem development. Coordinate with relevant corporate functions to support effective and compliant operations. Experience and Work Type This role requires 5-10 years of relevant experience. It is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Location The position is located in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

757522cf33e827c7.description: About the Role Edition is seeking a Bellman to join our team in the Red Sea region. 754832bbca9bcd9b.description: About MBRF and the Role MBRF is one of the world’s largest food companies, impacting thousands of families globally through quality and innovation. 755d6001034918b8.description: نبذة عن الدور تعلن شركة زهران للصيانه والتشغيل عن حاجتها لتوظيف حارس أمن بدوام كامل في محايل، عسير. يهدف هذا الدور إلى حماية الممتلكات والحفاظ على النظام داخل أماكن العمل من خلال المراقبة الدورية والتحكم في الدخول والخروج. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية مراقبة عمليات الدخول إلى المنشأة ومغادرتها، وإصدار التصاريح اللازمة لذلك. التحقق من هوية الموردين والزوار وتسجيل بياناتهم، وإصدار تصاريح الدخول لهم. القيام بدوريات منتظمة في أماكن العمل، وتفقد البوابات والأبواب والنوافذ لضمان سلامتها. المرور بين الزوار والموظفين للحفاظ على النظام وحماية الممتلكات، والتأكد من تطبيق اللوائح الداخلية للمنشأة. الاستجابة الفورية للإنذارات والتحقيق في الحوادث، والتواصل مع إدارات مكافحة الحرائق أو الإسعاف أو الشرطة عند الضرورة، وإبلاغ الإدارة بالوقائع. الالتزام الصارم بسياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة المعمول بها في الشركة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال الأمن أو الحراسة. القدرة على مراقبة الأماكن والممتلكات بفعالية. مهارات جيدة في التواصل والتعامل مع مختلف الأفراد. القدرة على اتخاذ قرارات سريعة ومناسبة في حالات الطوارئ. بيئة العمل يعمل حارس الأمن ضمن فريق شركة زهران للصيانه والتشغيل في مدينة محايل بمنطقة عسير. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب الالتزام بجدول عمل محدد لضمان الأمن المستمر للمنشأة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة الشخصية. التقديم ندعو المهتمين والذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذه الفرصة الوظيفية.

75ff82b7021bfbf8.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الاجير للموارد البشرية عن سكرتير تنفيذي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية تنظيم المواعيد، وإعداد المذكرات، وإجراء المراسلات، وحضور الاجتماعات، وتحرير المحاضر، بالإضافة إلى إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تنظيم مواعيد المدير/الرئيس وتذكيره بها بشكل فعال. التعامل مع الاستفسارات والرد عليها، وتوصيل البريد والمراسلات إلى المدير/الرئيس. إعداد المذكرات الدورية والمذكرات المتعلقة بعمل الوحدات التنظيمية الداخلية. إجراء المراسلات الاعتيادية مع الجهات الخارجية، والتأكد من توقيعها من المدير/الرئيس، ثم توزيعها. حضور الاجتماعات وتسجيل محاضرها وتحريرها بدقة. حفظ الوثائق والملفات المتعلقة بأعمال المدير/الرئيس بطريقة منظمة. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل، وتوثيقها وحفظها. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال السكرتارية التنفيذية أو دور مشابه. القدرة على تنظيم المهام المتعددة وإدارة الوقت بفعالية. مهارات ممتازة في التواصل الكتابي والشفوي. المهارات المطلوبة إتقان استخدام برامج الحاسوب المكتبية (مثل Microsoft Office). مهارات عالية في التنظيم والترتيب. القدرة على صياغة المراسلات والمذكرات والتقارير بشكل احترافي. الاهتمام بالتفاصيل والدقة في العمل. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في مدينة الرياض، وهو دور بدوام كامل ضمن بيئة عمل احترافية تدعم التطور الوظيفي. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين ممن تنطبق عليهم المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم.

75250782a085dc4b.description: About Shining 3D Shining 3D is a global technology company specializing in 3D digital solutions, with operations in China, Germany, and the * The company provides innovative solutions across various 3D imaging processes and technologies, including 3D scanning, reverse engineering, inspection, styling, design, analysis, digital manufacturing, and healthcare applications. Shining 3D serves diverse markets such as consumer products, automotive, aerospace, dental, biomechanics, education, heritage preservation & architecture, and multimedia industries, offering a range of products and services, alongside advanced training programs. The Role of Account Manager Metrology Shining 3D is seeking an Account Manager Metrology to join its team in Saudi Arabia. This full-time position involves managing key accounts and expanding sales channels for 3D scanners, photogrammetry systems, and 3D printers. The role requires a professional with 2-5 years of experience in capital equipment or industrial sales, focusing on generating revenue through product demonstrations and technical support. Key Responsibilities Ensure effective follow-up on business opportunities. Manage existing Key Accounts and expand new sales channels. Generate sales revenues by performing product demonstrations at customer sites. Evaluate customer requirements, including installation location, mounting, engineering drawings, CAD data, GD&T, and inspection plans. Develop expert knowledge of Shining 3D’s hardware and software products for marketing and sales demonstrations at trade shows and engineering associations. Identify additional sales opportunities outside of traditional channels. Utilize internal resources such as sales management, Inside Sales Specialists, Applications Engineers, and marketing to advance and close sales. Act as the primary point of contact and provide technical support to potential customers during the evaluation period. Communicate recommendations for hardware and software changes to Applications Engineers and R&D based on customer feedback. Achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual sales performance goals. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and work experience in metrology, mechanical engineering, manufacturing, surveying, or quality control is preferred. Minimum of 3 years of proven sales experience in Capital Equipment/Industrial Sales. Familiarity with 3D scanning products or industrial measurement; experience selling 3D related products is a strong advantage. Proficiency in English. Required Skills and Attributes Ability to work independently. Willingness to travel up to 40%. Work Environment This full-time role is based in Saudi Arabia and involves significant travel to customer sites for demonstrations and sales activities. The Account Manager will work independently while leveraging internal resources to achieve sales objectives.

751566745648393f.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة تكامل المرافق للتشغيل والصيانة عن فني صيانة ميكانيكية للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على ضمان الأداء الفعال للمنظومات والأجهزة والمعدات الميكانيكية من خلال تشخيص الأعطال وتنفيذ برامج الصيانة الوقائية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الصيانة الميكانيكية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تتبع المخططات الميكانيكية للمنظومات والأجهزة والمعدات الميكانيكية وتحديد إجراءات تشخيص الأعطال. تشخيص أعطال المنظومات والأجهزة والمعدات الميكانيكية، وتقدير كمية وتكلفة مواد ومستلزمات الصيانة ومتابعة توفيرها. متابعة إجراءات إصلاح الأعطال وفحص الأجهزة والمعدات الميكانيكية بعد الإصلاح للتأكد من دقة أدائها وضبطها. متابعة تنفيذ برامج الصيانة الوقائية للمنظومات والأجهزة والمعدات الميكانيكية بحسب البرامج المعتمدة. إعداد تقارير العمل وتقديمها وتوثيقها وحفظها بشكل دوري. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الصيانة الميكانيكية. القدرة على قراءة وتتبع المخططات الميكانيكية بدقة. مهارات قوية في تشخيص الأعطال الميكانيكية وتحديد أسبابها. القدرة على تقدير كمية وتكلفة المواد والمستلزمات اللازمة للصيانة. المهارات والكفاءات الدقة والاهتمام بالتفاصيل في فحص المعدات بعد الإصلاح. الالتزام ببرامج الصيانة الوقائية والجداول الزمنية المحددة. مهارات جيدة في إعداد وتقديم التقارير الفنية. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق والتعاون مع الزملاء. بيئة العمل يقع هذا الدور في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة، وهو وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق الصيانة في شركة تكامل المرافق للتشغيل والصيانة. تلتزم الشركة بتوفير بيئة عمل داعمة تساهم في تطوير مهارات الموظفين. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور. سيتم التواصل مع المرشحين المؤهلين لمناقشة الخطوات التالية في عملية التوظيف.

752eb25aa10f7ebd.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الاتحاد الهندسي السعودية للاستشارات الهندسية خطيب وعلمي عن أخصائي صحة وسلامة مهنية للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى ضمان بيئة عمل آمنة وصحية من خلال تحديد المخاطر المهنية وتطوير وتنفيذ الإجراءات الوقائية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تزيد عن 10 سنوات في مجال الصحة والسلامة المهنية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة بيئة العمل وتحديد المخاطر الكيميائية والفيزيائية والإشعاعية والبيولوجية في مواقع العمل. اقتراح أساليب وإجراءات فعالة لتفادي تأثيرات المخاطر على العاملين. تنسيق تحويل العاملين للفحص الطبي الدوري للتأكد من عدم تأثرهم بأمراض مهنية. قياس وفحص مستويات الإضاءة والتهوية والضجيج في مواقع العمل ومقارنتها بالمعايير المقبولة. التوصية بالإجراءات التصويبية اللازمة لتحسين ظروف العمل. مراقبة ومتابعة إجراءات التخلص من النفايات الصناعية السائلة والصلبة لضمان عدم تأثيرها على صحة البيئة. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات في مجال الصحة المهنية. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتعلقة بالصحة المهنية وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المنظمة. ضمان تطبيق مبادئ وقواعد السلامة العامة أثناء القيام بمختلف أعمال الصحة المهنية. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تزيد عن 10 سنوات في مجال الصحة والسلامة المهنية. القدرة على تحديد المخاطر المهنية المختلفة وتقييمها. معرفة عميقة بالمعايير واللوائح المتعلقة بالصحة والسلامة المهنية. مهارات ممتازة في إعداد التقارير والوثائق الفنية. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية، وهو وظيفة بدوام كامل تتطلب الالتزام بضمان أعلى معايير الصحة والسلامة في مشاريع الشركة المتنوعة. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريقنا، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم. سيتم التواصل مع المرشحين المؤهلين لمناقشة تفاصيل الدور.

75d5a6c63b53b8a2.description: About the Role Air Liquide is seeking a Basin & Key Account Manager for the KSA West Coast. This full-time role, based in Yanbu, combines comprehensive commercial ownership of the basin with strategic management of major key accounts. The position focuses on maximizing basin profitability, ensuring revenue and cash performance, securing long-term customer retention, and fostering sustainable growth. The manager will serve as the primary commercial lead for the Western basin and the central point of contact for key accounts, coordinating various internal functions while upholding safety, compliance, and governance standards. Key Responsibilities Strategic Key Account Management & Retention: Act as the primary commercial contact and end-to-end owner for the KSA West Coast basin portfolio. This includes managing daily performance across profitability, contractual obligations, retention, and service quality. Develop and execute 3-to-5-year Strategic Account Plans covering retention, growth, competitive threats, and joint value creation roadmaps (efficiency, reliability, optimization, expansion, and decarbonization). Build and maintain multi-level stakeholder matrices across customer and internal functions, leading Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and steering committees. Lead full contract lifecycle administration, including complex negotiations, amendments, renewals, extensions, and commercial settlements, ensuring timely action and protecting the company’s long-term position. Maintain oversight of customer and company obligations, contractual notices, payment terms, indexation, volume commitments, and proactive mitigation plans for competitive, contractual, or operational risks. Commercial Strategy, P&L & Working Capital Management: Formulate and execute the localized West Coast commercial strategy, reflecting customer priorities, market conditions, competitive dynamics, and long-term asset positioning. Own and actively manage revenue, margin/OI, pricing, volume performance, and commercial cost drivers, preparing annual budgets, rolling volume/revenue forecasts, and monthly actual-versus-forecast variance analyses. Implement approved pricing strategies, contractual indexation, and minimum volume/Take-or-Pay mechanisms to safeguard profitability and prevent revenue leakage. Validate monthly billing inputs and coordinate with Finance for accurate, timely invoice issuance and dispute resolution. Maintain commercial ownership of accounts receivable, monitor Days Sales Outstanding (DSO) and overdue aging, lead collection escalations, and partner with Credit Management to evaluate and mitigate payment exposures. Business Development, Growth, Operational Execution & Commercial Governance: Partner with Business Development and Technical teams to evaluate expansion projects, greenfield opportunities, and decarbonization initiatives, preparing business cases and commercial validation packages. Serve as the commercial lead during supply disruptions, major turnarounds, or operational events, driving commercial risk mitigation and managing claims or disputes. Champion customer requirements internally across Operations, Supply Chain, and Technical teams to translate feedback into service reliability improvements and seamless onboarding of newly commissioned projects. Ensure strict adherence to corporate governance, anti-bribery regulations, internal delegation of authority, and safety (EHS) standards, while maintaining accurate CRM records, contract documentation, and reporting to the Commercial Director. Qualifications and Experience 8-12 years of relevant professional experience. Work Type and Location This is a full-time position based in Yanbu, Saudi Arabia. Application Process Salary details for this position will be discussed during the interview process.

75394e69474826f7.description: About NAS Electric NAS Electric is a Saudi manufacturer and supplier of electrical wiring accessories and solutions, established in 2004 and based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The company serves retail, distribution, project, commercial, and residential markets across the Kingdom. Current strategic focus areas include market expansion, increasing sales productivity, strengthening collections, developing new customer channels, and building a performance-driven commercial organization. Role Overview NAS Electric is seeking a Commercial Development Manager to lead the commercial growth of the company. This is a full-time, field-oriented role based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, requiring 5-10 years of experience. The successful candidate will be responsible for leading the sales team, increasing collected sales, improving customer coverage, developing new accounts, strengthening collections, and identifying new commercial opportunities. This position involves direct engagement with sales representatives, customers, distributors, contractors, and internal departments. Key Responsibilities Lead, manage, and develop the sales team, setting monthly sales and collection targets. Monitor individual and team performance using KPIs and conduct regular field visits with sales representatives. Develop and execute plans to increase monthly collected sales across retail, distribution, contractor, and project channels. Identify and acquire new retailers, distributors, contractors, project customers, and strategic accounts. Work with sales representatives and finance to improve collections, follow up on overdue balances, and reduce overdue receivables. Strengthen relationships with key accounts, monitor customer activity, and resolve commercial issues affecting retention. Monitor competitor activity, conduct market visits, and report on emerging opportunities and threats. Ensure sales comply with approved pricing and discount policies, reviewing major quotations and commercial opportunities. Collaborate with management and operations to develop commercial plans for slow-moving inventory. Support marketing activities by recommending promotions, supporting product launches, and evaluating commercial effectiveness. Prepare weekly and monthly reports on sales performance, collections, new customers, market activity, and other key metrics. Coordinate with Finance, Production, Warehouse, Purchasing, and Marketing to ensure operational alignment with commercial commitments. Qualifications and Experience 5–8 years of experience in B2B sales, commercial development, or business development. Proven experience in managing, supervising, or leading sales teams is strongly preferred. Demonstrated experience in field sales, not solely office-based or digital sales. Strong experience in customer acquisition and account development. Experience working with credit customers and collections is highly preferred. Ability to manage sales teams using KPIs, CRM systems, and performance reports. Strong negotiation skills and commercial judgment. Proficiency in Excel or spreadsheets and CRM systems. Ability to prepare clear commercial reports and action plans. Strong communication, follow-up, and leadership skills. Comfortable working under performance targets. Preferred Industry Background Candidates with experience in the following sectors are strongly preferred: Electrical products or wiring accessories. Lighting, building materials, sanitary products, or HVAC. Construction supplies or industrial products. Distribution-based B2B businesses. Candidate Profile and Career Growth The ideal candidate is comfortable spending significant time in the market, can lead a sales team while remaining personally involved with key customers, and is highly disciplined in follow-up. This individual understands both sales and collections, uses numbers and KPIs to manage performance, and can identify weak performance for corrective action. The role offers the opportunity to grow into a broader commercial leadership position based on demonstrated performance and business results.

754bcb901b16d3f9.description: About Hatch and the Role Hatch is a global engineering, project management, and professional services firm. In Saudi Arabia, the company collaborates with government entities and regulatory bodies on projects aligned with Vision 2030. We are seeking a Government Relations Officer to join our team in Riyadh. This full-time role focuses on ensuring compliance with local regulations, streamlining government processes, and maintaining relationships with key authorities. Role Context and Contribution As part of the Shared Services group, which includes Finance, Marketing, Communications, Human Resources, Commercial, Legal, and Facilities, this position supports the business in achieving its objectives. The Government Relations Officer contributes to the delivery of services through specialized skills, established methodologies, and robust systems. Key Responsibilities Act as the primary point of contact between Hatch and government authorities, managing official communications, documentation, and approvals. Build and maintain productive relationships with ministries and regulatory bodies to facilitate company operations. Monitor regulatory changes and advise internal teams on requirements and potential impacts. Manage and maintain all company licenses, registrations, and certificates with local authorities, ensuring timely renewals. Prepare, review, and submit necessary documentation to government agencies accurately and efficiently. Oversee visa, work permit, and Iqama processes for employees, including onboarding, renewals, transfers, and amendments. Manage all workforce-related transactions through government platforms such as Qiwa, Muqeem, Absher, GOSI, and Mudad. Ensure compliance with Saudi labor law, Saudization requirements, and all applicable regulations. Develop and update internal procedures for licensing, visas, and government interactions. Coordinate with HR, Finance, and Project teams to ensure alignment with regulatory requirements. Maintain accurate records, reports, and documentation to support compliance and audits. Maintain client portals with accurate information and coordinate requests and initiatives. Support the resolution of employee-related government cases, ensuring adherence to local labor laws and internal policies. Identify risks and challenges related to government processes and propose proactive solutions. Work Environment and Opportunities The Government Relations Officer will work on projects that contribute to Saudi Vision 2030. This role is part of a collaborative and globally connected team, offering opportunities for professional growth within an international firm. Hatch provides a flexible work environment and supports long-term career development, encouraging a global perspective while working locally in the Riyadh Region.

755a436ee28f2ca6.description: About Arab Center for Engineering Studies (ACES) Arab Center for Engineering Studies (ACES) is a specialized engineering company operating across the Middle East. The company provides a range of engineering services, including site and geotechnical investigation, materials technology and testing, quality control, special studies, land and marine surveying, and chemical and environmental testing. ACES focuses on delivering reliable, cost-effective, and quality engineering solutions to its clients. Job Summary The Senior Calibration Engineer will coordinate construction testing activities with technicians and clients, ensuring site labs meet equipment specifications and possess valid calibration certificates. This full-time role, based in Al Khobar, Eastern, Saudi Arabia, involves issuing testing reports, ensuring all testing adheres to required specifications, and leading a team to maintain efficiency. The position requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities This role encompasses both managerial and technical duties, reporting directly to the Calibration Technical Section Head. Managerial Duties: Implement company policies, goals, objectives, and procedures, and support their development. Oversee the implementation of operations plans and monitor costs and resources. Avoid conflicts of interest to ensure impartiality in assessments and maintain confidentiality of data and calibration results. Technical Duties: Respond to customer inquiries regarding calibration progress and reporting. Prepare and initially check calibration reports for approval. Analyze data and conduct corrective actions to prevent non-conforming items. Set calibration schedules and supervise work performed by supervisors and technicians. Communicate with equipment suppliers/vendors and calibration agencies for purchasing, calibration, and rental. Review master equipment certificates, calibration agencies' CMCs, and suppliers’ proposals. Evaluate requests, prepare, and provide quotes and bids for calibration, maintenance, and special inspection works. Conduct calibration/verification and special inspection reports, communicating results to relevant parties. Ensure tests are carried out according to standard test methods/work instructions and customer requirements. Conduct analysis of test results from technicians, ensuring compliance with national and international standards. Ensure all site/lab equipment is fit for use through calibration and maintenance programs. Investigate non-conformities and implement corrective and preventive actions. Review related orders to ensure all required information is clear. Ensure proper storage of received items, maintaining specified storage conditions and handling requirements. Supervise lab supervisors and data entry personnel. Review and approve certificates, technical proposals, and special reports in coordination with the Calibration Head. Provide technical training and adopt new calibration technologies. Reporting Structure The Senior Calibration Engineer reports to the Calibration Technical Section Head and has direct reports including Calibration Lab Supervisors, Technicians, and Data Entry personnel. Commitment to Sustainability ACES integrates sustainability into its daily operations and strategic direction, guided by the ISO 14001 Environmental Management Standard.
